story.title: Whole night, best held-out subject
story.watch: Every advance and retract across the night: 104/104 arousal-linked events covered with 13 advances, jaw forward 67% of the night against 100% for a fixed MAD.

model.pack: no hypnogram-wake (deployable), 1 Hz every cannula-valid second after 600 s lookback
model.fusion: Advance only if fire_now is above threshold (early-warn when pre_onset also high; rescue when active is also high). active-only holds if already advanced. pre_onset without fire_now does not actuate.

cohort.note: Cohort context for the selected night: median over all held-out nights scored end to end at this threshold.

controller.fusion: fire_now primary; pre_onset early-warn; active hold/rescue

meta.disclaimer: Untreated PSG: coverage is timing (advance completed before the arousal deadline), not proven event or arousal prevention. Best of 168 held-out nights scored end to end (7 met the demo gates); this is a selected night, not a cohort average.
